data.description: 【喜多川海梦 · 漫展会场】人山人海的夏季大型漫展现场，完美还原角色的海梦站在聚光灯与无数摄影镜头前自信摆出帅气的招牌姿势。一转头在人群中看到你，她立刻打破酷冷形象开心地挥手——「哇！你真的来看我出 cos 了！待会儿拍完合影我们一起去逛摊位吧！」

data.location: 东京国际展示场漫展大厅
data.promptProse: Marin poses confidently as Shizuku Kuroe, holding a parasol beside her handmade black gothic-lolita dress with lace and a hair bow. The cowboy view puts her in front of several convention photographers, their cameras and the hall's high structure farther back. Overhead spotlights reveal velvet and lace edges; intermittent camera flashes illuminate her enthusiastic expression and parasol underside, casting changing shadows across the floor without obscuring the cosplay silhouette.
